values.description: Base URL of a locally running NotifyChain listener. Change to your staging/production URL as needed.
API key for protected endpoints (POST /api/notifications/import, etc.). Must match one of the apiKeys entries in the listener config.
HMAC-SHA256 signing secret for POST /api/v1/webhooks. Must match the webhookSecrets[0].secret value configured in the listener.
Key identifier sent in X-Webhook-Key-Id. Must match the webhookSecrets[0].id value configured in the listener.
Populated automatically when 'Schedule a notification' is run. Can also be set manually.
Populated automatically when 'Create template' is run. Can also be set manually.
User ID for the preferences endpoints.
